policy.scope: Species-specific worn overlays for existing items only. No new item types, gameplay, stats, or availability changes.
policy.priority: Keep an existing verified Vox sprite. Use missing_only entries only where none exists; reviewed_replacement entries replace documented unconverted human-shaped donor states.
policy.greyscale: Keep existing supported Vox greyscale families. Precoloured Paradise entries do not replace greyscale_config_worn or player-selected colours.
policy.transform: Identity unless an entry explicitly declares a reviewed transform.
policy.security_collision: Paradise security/warden/hos are red uniforms. TG grey security/warden/hos states intentionally do not inherit those aliases.
